# The question

## How can a sequence model connect distant tokens?

Our workspace follows the shift from recurrence to attention.

- [Read the literature review](../../lit-review/index.qmd).
- [Open the paper](../../paper/html/index.qmd).

# The mechanism

## Attention weights the available context

$$
\operatorname{Attention}(Q,K,V) = \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V
$$

The weights combine values for each query.

## Follow the computation {.dim-previous}

::: {.fragment}
Compare a query with the available keys.
:::

::: {.fragment}
Normalize the scores into weights.
:::

::: {.fragment}
Combine the values using those weights.
:::
